graphEvents.label: Which threshold or constant moves offer rate and what is its floor risk
False offers are protected by measured phrase absence while typed and scorer floors need a re-pin

label: All 17 proposed phrases return 0 matches across the 31 none prompts, so the pinned false-offer set cannot move by construction and the residual risk is only an unseen paraphrase.
An sk-doc vocabulary change is a two-artifact change, the hub source and the compiled policy snapshot, and the 22-case canary already pins one-turn-clarify and zero-signal-defer.

The matched doctor command needs its default invocation carried on the match because the base /doctor:agents-md has no policy row; the route manifest marks check as the read-only default, ci report read-only and deep-loop add-only under policy run.

Expected exact offers rise from 3 to 14 plus 2 conversions across the 16 chat rows, covering all 11 missing rows on paper: deep hub +3, sk-doc +3, explicit anchors +3, doctor +2 new and 2 conversions.

Floor exposure is asymmetric: false offers are protected by phrase absence, typed recall is exposed through PHRASE_BOOSTS reordering and must be re-pinned, and the scorer eval can move either way so the calibration override is the dry-run surface.

Ranking by new exact offers plus half a conversion over a risk weight puts deep hub aliases and the doctor cluster first at 3.0, sk-doc aliases at 2.0, explicit anchors at 1.5 and the metadata re-embed last.
